provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^341 - 1 with a(x) = x^46 + x^55 + x^78 + x^83 + x^108 + x^109 + x^213 + x^269 + x^308 + x^337, b(x) = x^9 + x^21 + x^56 + x^89 + x^190 + x^192 + x^196 + x^261 + x^270 + x^289 + x^295 + x^310; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T]. a and b are low-weight codewords of the ideal of a divisor of x^341 - 1 of degree 51, fixing k = 2 deg gcd(a, b, x^m - 1) = 102.
provenance.notes: Designed-divisor construction: the divisor is a product of cyclotomic-coset minimal polynomials over GF(2^ord_2(m)), so its degree and hence k are chosen rather than inherited, and a and b are drawn from its ideal by information-set decoding. Both single-block kernels have dimension deg gcd(a, b, x^m - 1) = 51 exactly, so the code carries no circulant block wider than k requires. Distance is a witness-backed upper bound from 24 random information-set seeds at 2,000,000 trials each (spread 90-96); an orbit fold over every equal-orbit partition bottoms at 110 and a single-block circulant search at 8 seeds x 600,000 trials finds nothing under 101. Both witnesses re-verified against these matrices.
